section.title: Starting CTDI measurement
section.hierarchy_path: /System operation/Function tests/Using the Customer CTDI service function/Starting CTDI measurement

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Starting CTDI measurement
You do not need a personal account and password for the Customer CTDI service function.
The special scan protocols have been defined according to your requirements.
The scan protocols are saved in the special folder with the required file names and file types.
The current patient study is closed.
1 Call up Options > Service > Local Service, delete the password entries, and click OK .
The Home Menu dialog window is displayed.
2 Click on the Quality Assurance button to display the Quality window.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
4 System operation
3 Select Quality > Customer CTDI in the Quality window.

4 The software is displaying a list of the scan protocols in the Special folder. Select the desired scan protocol from the list, and a sequence scan is generated and parameters are displayed on the screen.
The protocol is loaded.
If no protocol could be loaded, check the following steps:
◆ Remove non-used ranges and recon jobs. ( Page 176 Deleting all non-used ranges and recon jobs)
◆ Deactivate CARE Dose4D on the Scan parameter card. ( Page 176 Adapting the scan protocol parameters)
◆ Save the scan protocol as CTDI_* in the Special folder. ( Page 177 Saving the defined scan protocol)
5 If the protocol has been loaded successfully, you are prompted to insert the required CTDI phantom and prepare the dosimeter.
Click Go when you have completed your preparations.
Follow the instructions on the screen to perform the CTDI measurement.
7 Press the Start key on the control box.
The system starts the CTDI measurement.
8 When the scan is successfully completed, an image is automatically saved to the Service Patient in the Customer CTDI study.
The image is assigned with a series for each scan protocol type used. Each series also carries the same name as the protocol type associated with it.
9 Click Repeat to repeat the measurement.
New CTDI measurements generate another image in the image series.
The images are overwritten when starting a new CTDI measurement with the same scan mode. To archive the data of the CTDI measurement, use another storage or storage media.
– or –
Click Done to finish the CTDI measurement.
The Customer CTDI service function is completed and the database is automatically cleaned up.
